text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. At Tracen Academy, a 
Christmas party hosted by the Student 
Council was underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Held for the Umamusume with no plans to go 
out, it's an annual casual party open to 
voluntary participants, but—
choice_data_list:
(To think there's a dress code this 
year...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, having a Trainer 
present is mandatory. Since Buena Vista 
invited me out, I couldn't very well 
refuse—
choice_data_list:
(I tried to tidy it up... but I wonder if 
it's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, stooop~. Time for an inspection!
choice_data_list: Tran... Wait, that outfit—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Formal attire is required, after all~ 
Anyway, putting me aside for a second.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm... hmhmhm. Oho oho oho...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Brainpower and muscle power are both 
sufficient. As for charm... that's gone up 
considerably over the past 3 years. Yep, 
all good overall!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you two look great together. 
Have fun~.
choice_data_list: Wh-What was that...?
Wh-What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Was she checking on my outfit? With 
that thought in mind, I hurriedly made my 
way to the party venue where Buena Vista 
was waiting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the venue, everyone was 
dressed to the nines, transforming the 
usual cafeteria into a truly glamorous 
space.
choice_data_list: (Buena Vista is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I found her right away. No 
matter how thick the crowd, her 
sunflower-like brightness is impossible to 
miss."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, you're all coming to watch the 
Arima Kinen together...!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! This year belongs to you, 
Buena-chan. You can definitely win, do 
your best!
choice_data_list: (Surrounded by a crowd as always, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was a great opportunity, and I wanted 
her to talk with all sorts of people. So 
as I watched over her from afar for a 
while—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Finally here! ...I'm gonna slip away 
for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting, Trainer-san. ...Your 
formal attire looks wonderful!
choice_data_list: ...How did you realize that?
...How did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Why, you ask...? Hehe!
choice_data_list: Why are you laughing...?
Why are you laughing...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: There's no way I wouldn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
There's no one else as wonderful as them 
anywhere in the world.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right. Is it okay if I give you 
your Christmas present now?"
choice_data_list: Did you prepare this for me?
Did you get this ready for me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Consider it a token of my daily 
appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Sports wear and shoes. Yellow and brown... 
I matched them using my favorite colors♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we run the perimeter, you follow 
along on a bike or in a car, right, 
Trainer? But... I'd be so happy if we 
could... run at the same speed together.
choice_data_list: ...I'll do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you. I know it's asking for 
the impossible, but... will you let me 
root for you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. Seeing you two standing side by 
side, you really do make a great match.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san...! You're so incredibly cool 
too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, well, this kind of thing is all 
about riding the vibe. Don't worry about 
me—"
choice_data_list:
Oh yeah, thanks for everything up until 
now.

Oh yeah, thank you for everything up until 
now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right, Tran-san is always 
watching over me so kindly...!
choice_data_list:
She was checking if my outfit was okay 
earlier too...

She was checking if my outfit was okay 
earlier too...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even all the way out there! 
...You're really so kind, Tran-san!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
......No seriously, you two are way too 
perfect for each other.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not about stats or anything... maybe 
what really matters is having hearts of 
the same color...

a close...

all thanks to you"— I swallowed back the
